decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates for 3D integration and high-frequency applications sit close to the firm's core glass processing, so carrying costs are low, while the glass-substrate packaging market is still emerging and uncertain, which makes keeping the option valuable.

VLIS was only launched in 2024 as a flagship technology for through-glass vias, so its value is far from resolved, and it complements Product A within the firm's few strategic advanced-packaging options, which strongly favors continuing.
